name: LASALLE College of the Arts
summary: Singapore arts college with sixteen three-year BA (Hons) degrees in art, design, film, music and performance, entered by portfolio or audition.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is a listed entry qualification with no points or subjects set; selection is by portfolio, audition or statement of purpose plus an online interview. IELTS 6.0 if not English-medium.

programmes.name: Acting
programmes.about: A conservatory-style acting degree training actors in acting, voice and movement techniques such as mime, silat, Suzuki, biomechanics or Le Jeu, with theory and research tied to performance.
programmes.selectionNote: Two contrasting speeches from memory (one Shakespeare, one contemporary, 5 minutes in all), then an online interview. Online audition if you cannot attend.

programmes.name: Animation Art
programmes.about: Animation study at the Puttnam School of Film and Animation, where short films, documentaries and animation are made inside a wider creative arts environment.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Art Histories and Curatorial Practices: Asia and the World
programmes.about: Joins art history and curatorial practice rather than treating them as separate disciplines, with a regional focus on Asia and the world.
programmes.selectionNote: A 300-word statement of purpose, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Arts Management
programmes.about: Covers contemporary issues and policy shaping the creative sector and arts markets, building leadership, business, communication and managerial skills for the arts and cultural industries.
programmes.selectionNote: A 300-word statement of purpose, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Design Communication
programmes.about: A visual communication degree about how design shapes everyday communication, preparing you to contribute to contemporary visual culture, social practice and the new economy.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Design for Social Futures
programmes.about: Builds flexibility in leadership, co-creation and collaboration through service design, user-interface and user-experience design, data, social design and speculative and strategic design.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Fashion Design and Textiles
programmes.about: Focuses on designing and constructing the fashion garment, with craftsmanship, sustainability and sociocultural questions, in practical workshops and industry projects.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Fashion Media and Industries
programmes.about: A multidisciplinary degree in fashion media and communication and in fashion entrepreneurship, built for the new creative roles emerging in the fashion industry.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Film
programmes.about: Develops you as a total filmmaker, from script to screen, with a high level of technical and narrative artistry and a focus on your own authorship.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Fine Arts
programmes.about: Contemporary fine art practice from traditional disciplines to emergent art forms, built around debate, questioning conventions and a wide choice of ways to express yourself.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Interior Design
programmes.about: Designs spaces and experiential environments from human behaviour and emotion, drawing on architecture, lighting, furniture and exhibition design and working with industry professionals.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: International Contemporary Dance Practices
programmes.about: Develops independent, experimental dance artists across Singapore and London, with visiting international artists and performance in live and digital contexts.
programmes.selectionNote: On-site admissions workshop in London or Singapore (technique, then improvisation), with an interview at the end. Year 1 is in London.

programmes.name: Music
programmes.about: Contemporary music study with five specialist areas: popular music performance, electronic music, jazz performance, composition and arranging, and classical performance.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition recording for your specialism, then an online interview. This degree closes later than the others.
programmes.closesNote: Music closes later than the other degrees

separateFrom.name: Music Business
separateFrom.reason: Music is an audition degree in performance and composition; Music Business is entered by statement of purpose and trains for the industry side.

programmes.name: Music Business
programmes.about: Prepares you to lead in the global music industry, from launching artistes and marketing campaigns to producing and distributing music, with flexible electives.
programmes.selectionNote: A 300-word statement of purpose, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

separateFrom.name: Music
separateFrom.reason: Music Business is entered by statement of purpose and trains for the industry side; Music is an audition degree in performance and composition.

programmes.name: Musical Theatre
programmes.about: Trains performers for musical theatre, an art form where gifted, highly trained performers sit alongside directors, choreographers, designers and musicians.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition (online if you cannot attend), then an online interview about your pieces. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

programmes.name: Product Design
programmes.about: Develops designers of tangible and intangible products through design research, analytical thinking and empathy, working across sectors and disciplines.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio of 10 to 15 original pieces, then an online interview about it. Academics need good passes after 12 years of schooling.

notes: Degrees are conferred by the University of the Arts Singapore; students who started before August 2024 graduate with a Goldsmiths, University of London degree.
Further application windows may open if seats remain, but the dates above are the published ones; the fee is S$120 per application for international applicants.
Portfolios are judged on originality; LASALLE prefers work not made with AI tools and rejects copied or fan art.
